summary: The implementation adds a shared identity and organization contract across OSS and Enterprise, additive tenant-scoped persistence, email OTP and OIDC session flows, privacy-aware user administration, local and SCIM group coexistence, business-category administration, a shared Console, and Enterprise SCIM/RLS support while preserving existing principals, ACLs, API keys, and tenant provisioning boundaries.
decision_refs: tenant remains the operator-provisioned isolation and contract unit
new users receive opaque stable principals while existing principals remain unchanged
full_name is private to self and tenant_admin while display_name is directory-safe
email and SCIM ship disabled until bootstrap administration is complete
residual_risks: Versioned packages and OCI images still require an explicitly authorized release operation.
Production SMTP, OIDC discovery, and Okta-compatible SCIM require post-deployment canary evidence.
